name: The Westin Punta Cana Resort & Club

address.street: Playa Blanca at Puntacana Resort & Club

insider_take: This expansive beachfront sanctuary sits on one of the Caribbean's most pristine stretches of white sand, where crystalline waters meet swaying coconut palms in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The Westin Punta Cana boasts the exclusive Heavenly Spa by Westin™ featuring indigenous Taíno-inspired treatments using local ingredients like coconut oil and sea salt. The resort's signature restaurant, Mosaic, offers farm-to-table Caribbean fusion cuisine sourcing from the hotel's own organic herb garden.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise yoga session on the beach - Punta Cana's eastern coastline offers some of the most spectacular sunrises in the Caribbean, and the hotel's WestinWORKOUT® fitness concierge can arrange private sessions.
dont_miss: The nearby Indigenous Eyes Ecological Park & Reserve features 12 freshwater lagoons perfect for swimming, plus you're just minutes from Hoyo Azul - a stunning natural cenote with impossibly blue water nestled within Scape Park's tropical landscape.
pros: Premium beachfront location with pristine white sand and crystal-clear waters
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds and wellness-focused amenities
Multiple dining venues offering diverse culinary experiences
Comprehensive resort facilities including pools, spa, and water sports
cons: Large resort property may feel crowded during peak seasons
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and brand standards
